No gitleaks or trufflehog is available, so the fallback pattern scan of the diff was used and found no hardcoded credentials; NFR-004 is satisfied (the package reads no environment variable). No performance, accessibility or SEO NFR exists in this feature, so no /sdrive:performance report or not_verified mark is required.
